title: Sustaining productivity gains in the face of climate change: A research agenda for US wheat
abstract: Wheat is a globally important crop and one of the “big three” US field crops. But unlike the other two (maize and soybean), in the United States its development is commercially unattractive, and so its breeding takes place primarily in public universities. Troublingly, the incentive structures within these universities may be hindering genetic improvement just as climate change is complicating breeding efforts. “Business as usual” in the US public wheat‐breeding infrastructure may not sustain productivity increases. To address this concern, we held a multidisciplinary conference in which researchers from 12 US (public) universities and one European university shared the current state of knowledge in their disciplines, aired concerns, and proposed initiatives that could facilitate maintaining genetic improvement of wheat in the face of climate change. We discovered that climate‐change‐oriented breeding efforts are currently considered too risky and/or costly for most university wheat breeders to undertake, leading to a relative lack of breeding efforts that focus on abiotic stressors such as drought and heat. We hypothesize that this risk/cost burden can be reduced through the development of appropriate germplasm, relevant screening mechanisms, consistent germplasm characterization, and innovative models predicting the performance of germplasm under projected future climate conditions. However, doing so will require coordinated, longer‐term, inter‐regional efforts to generate phenotype data, and the modification of incentive structures to consistently reward such efforts.
abstract_zh: 小麦是全球重要的作物，也是美国“三大”大田作物之一。但与另外两种作物（玉米和大豆）不同，在美国，小麦的商业开发缺乏吸引力，因此其育种工作主要由公立大学承担。令人担忧的是，恰在气候变化使育种工作更加复杂之际，这些大学内部的激励结构可能正在阻碍遗传改良。美国公立小麦育种体系的“照常运行”可能无法维持生产力的持续提高。为应对这一担忧，我们召开了一次多学科会议，来自美国12所公立大学和一所欧洲大学的研究人员交流了各自学科的知识现状，表达了担忧，并提出了有助于在气候变化背景下维持小麦遗传改良的倡议。我们发现，对大多数大学小麦育种人员而言，面向气候变化的育种工作被认为风险过高和/或成本过大，因此相对缺乏针对干旱和高温等非生物胁迫的育种努力。我们推测，通过开发适宜的种质资源、相关筛选机制、一致的种质特征描述，以及预测种质在未来气候条件下表现的创新模型，可以降低这种风险与成本负担。然而，要做到这一点，需要协调一致的长期跨区域努力以生成表型数据，并改革激励结构，以持续奖励此类工作。

Can Customary Land Tenure Facilitate Agricultural Productivity Growth? Evidence from Burkina Faso
abstract: In Burkina Faso, land is managed through customary tenure, which discourages land rentals and sales. Yet it permits land transactions through an institution called borrowing. This study investigates whether the borrowed status of land affects the seasonal crop and input choices as well as longer-term, productivity-enhancing investments made on it. Analysis using nationally representative, plot-level data from the Enquête Permanente Agricole suggests that borrowed land is more intensively farmed in terms of cropping and inputs. We find no evidence of borrowed lands having fewer erosion-preventing investments or of being fallowed less than nonborrowed (inherited) land. (JEL O13, O17)
abstract_zh: 在布基纳法索，土地通过习惯产权制度进行管理，这种制度抑制了土地的租赁和出售。然而，它允许通过一种称为“借用”（borrowing）的制度进行土地交易。本研究考察了借用土地的身份是否会影响季节性作物与投入品选择，以及在其上进行的、有助于提高长期生产率的投资。利用具有全国代表性的地块层面数据（Enquête Permanente Agricole）的分析表明，借用土地在种植和投入方面的集约化程度更高。我们没有发现借用土地在防侵蚀投资方面较少、或休耕频率低于非借用（继承）土地的证据。（JEL O13, O17）

title: Does experience with agricultural loans improve farmers' well-being? Evidence from Benin
abstract:
Purpose
The purpose of this study is to examine the effect of loans provided by Benin's largest microlender.
Design/methodology/approach
A pipeline design and matching techniques contribute for identifying the causal effect. The loan treatment considered is loan experience. It includes program entry timing, take-up frequency and the amount obtained over six years. The study uses a cluster analysis to create comparison groups.
Findings
Experience with agricultural loans has a statistically significantly positive effect on recipients' farm income, food security and women's empowerment. Though unusual, these positive results can be credited to the very low rate of loan repurposing and mostly to the lender's rigorous loan implementation strategy.
Practical implications
The study results validate the hypothesis underlying development strategies that target women regarding loan programs. The study provides a simple yet valuable lesson for future credit impact evaluations: the context of the loan program as well as the evaluation indicators is essential.
Social implications
This study’s findings suggest that microcredit, when offered judiciously and with support, can improve farmers' conditions.
Originality/value
Given the relatively long period studied, the analysis has been innovative in defining loan treatment and creating reliable treatment groups. Also to the best of the authors’ knowledge, this study is the first of its kind in Benin.
abstract_zh:
目的
本研究旨在考察贝宁最大的小额贷款机构所提供贷款的效应。
设计/方法/途径
采用管道式（pipeline）设计和匹配技术来识别因果效应。所考察的贷款处理是贷款经历，包括项目参与时点、借款频率以及六年间获得的金额。本研究使用聚类分析来构建对照组。
研究发现
农业贷款经历对受援者的农场收入、粮食安全和女性赋权具有统计上显著的正向影响。尽管并不常见，这些正面结果可归因于贷款挪用率极低，并主要归功于该机构严谨的贷款执行策略。
实践意义
研究结果验证了面向女性的贷款项目发展战略所依据的假设。本研究为未来的信贷影响评估提供了一个简单而有价值的启示：贷款项目的背景以及评估指标至关重要。
社会意义
本研究发现表明，若小额信贷能够审慎提供并辅以支持，便可改善农民的状况。
原创性/价值
鉴于研究所覆盖的时期较长，本分析在界定贷款处理以及构建可靠的处理组方面具有创新性。同时，据作者所知，这是贝宁首个此类研究。

title: The role of liquidity in preventing dis-investment in crop inputs: Evidence from Zambia
abstract: Despite the current focus on asset smoothing, very few studies consider how seasonal crop input decisions are affected by income shocks. If households cope with ‘bad’ harvests by cutting back on production inputs in the following seasons, they are likely to be slowing down their economic recovery. If such shocks increase in frequency, the ability to recover quickly becomes critical. This study posits that access to liquidity sources plays a role in determining a household’s investments in crop inputs following low-harvest years. Using nationally representative, household-level panel survey data from rural Zambia, we test for differential effects—by household liquidity level—of rainfall shocks on input investments in own-farm production. We estimate semi-elasticities, with respect to these shocks, of four maize inputs: basal fertilizer, top dressing fertilizer, improved maize seed and area planted to maize. Crucially, we allow the magnitude of these input adjustments to differ by household liquidity indicators, as measured by chickens, small livestock (sheep, goats, pigs), cattle, off-farm income and access to fertilizer subsidies. Our findings suggest that rainfall shocks negatively affect the use of some maize inputs. Importantly, households with cattle and access to the national fertilizer subsidy program show significantly smaller reductions in the use of mineral fertilizer. Curiously, we also observe that households with poultry and small livestock reduce their fertilizer use even more than those without.
abstract_zh: 尽管当前研究聚焦于资产平滑，但很少有研究考察季节性作物投入决策如何受到收入冲击的影响。如果家庭应对“歉收”的方式是在随后的季节削减生产投入，那么他们很可能会减缓自身的经济复苏。如果此类冲击的频率增加，迅速恢复的能力就变得至关重要。本研究认为，获取流动性的渠道在决定家庭在低收成年份之后对作物投入的投资方面发挥作用。利用赞比亚农村地区具有全国代表性的家庭层面面板调查数据，我们检验了降雨冲击对自有农场生产投入的影响在家庭流动性水平上是否存在差异。我们估计了这些冲击对四种玉米投入品的半弹性：基肥、追肥、改良玉米种子以及玉米种植面积。关键的是，我们允许这些投入调整的幅度因家庭流动性指标而异，这些指标包括鸡、小型牲畜（绵羊、山羊、猪）、牛、非农收入以及化肥补贴的获取情况。我们的研究结果表明，降雨冲击对某些玉米投入品的使用产生了负面影响。重要的是，拥有牛以及能够获得全国化肥补贴计划的家庭，其矿物肥料使用量的减少幅度显著更小。值得注意的是，我们还观察到，拥有家禽和小型牲畜的家庭，其化肥使用量的减少幅度甚至比没有这些牲畜的家庭更大。

title: User responses to imperfect forecasts: Findings from an experiment with Kentucky wheat farmers
abstract: Weather and climate forecasts can help agricultural producers improve management choices in anticipation of uncertain growing conditions. Current literature conjectures that the extent to which forecasts are useful depends on their accuracy, that is, the probability with which a forecasted event, such as precipitation, is projected to occur. Too little accuracy can potentially render forecasts effectively useless, even if they convey some form of information. In this study, we collect farmer-based data through a questionnaire and a framed field experiment to test for the existence of an accuracy threshold for forecasts, below which forecasts do not induce any behavioral changes. We do this in the context of a very specific management choice—the timing and amount of nitrogen that Kentucky farmers apply to their wheat in early spring—in response to randomly generated 6-to-10-day forecasts of rainfall conditions. We find that forecasts provide economically significant value to decision-makers only when they depart dramatically from what is normally expected. These results have implications that extend beyond the nitrogen-application decision for winter wheat: if this type of behavior is widespread, at current accuracy levels, other types of forecasts may be of little value to decision-makers and therefore go unheeded.
abstract_zh: 天气和气候预报有助于农业生产者在面对不确定的生长条件时，改善管理决策。现有文献推测，预报的有用程度取决于其准确性，即某一预报事件（如降水）被预测发生的概率。准确性过低可能使预报实际上毫无用处，即使它传递了某种信息。在本研究中，我们通过问卷调查和框架化田间实验收集了农民数据，以检验预报是否存在一个准确性阈值，低于该阈值时预报不会引起任何行为改变。我们是在一个非常具体的管理选择背景下进行的：肯塔基州小麦种植者在早春时节，根据随机生成的6至10天降雨预报，决定施氮的时间和数量。我们发现，只有当预报与通常预期发生显著偏离时，预报才能为决策者提供具有经济意义的价值。这些结果的意义超出了冬小麦施氮决策本身：如果这种行为具有普遍性，那么在当前的准确性水平下，其他类型的预报对决策者而言可能价值甚微，从而被忽视。

title: Governing livelihood and land use transitions: The role of customary tenure in southeastern Morocco
Destination or distraction? Querying the linkage between off-farm work and food crop investments in Kenya
abstract: Off-farm earnings account for a substantial and growing share of household income among smallholder farmers in most of Sub-Saharan Africa, but evidence concerning the effects of these earnings on investment in food production remains sparse. Conceptually, some factors may push farm families to send members in search of cash to relieve expenditure constraints or serve to meet consumption needs under duress; other factors pull members of rural households toward the promise of steady, dependable income. Previously published research suggests that the search for off-farm income has a negative impact on farm investments.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲的大多数地区，非农收入在小农家庭收入中占有相当大且日益增长的份额，但关于这些收入对粮食生产投资影响的证据仍然稀少。从概念上讲，一些因素可能促使农户家庭成员外出寻找现金，以缓解支出约束，或在迫不得已时满足消费需要；另一些因素则将农村家庭成员吸引至稳定可靠的收入前景。已发表的研究表明，寻求非农收入对农业投资具有负面影响。
